What game? (I don't know how to code, but I love board games!)

A Mighty Fortress. Set in the age of Reformation, 6 players control England, France, the Hapsburg Empire, the Papacy, the Lutherans and the Ottoman Empire as Europe undergoes a religious transformation.

Each player has its own set of objectives, either to politically control certain areas and cities, or to ensure certain provinces are either Lutheran in religion or Catholic.

It's a really fun game if you can get 6 players who are committed, but with fewer you can make some adjustments such as having a player control two nations (such as the Ottomans and England), or by having the whole set of players control the Papacy by consensus.

Just a warning about Py2exe... Make sure your code is friendly. There are known conversion issues (even though I've used it numerous times playing around with writing games as I learned the language/platform).
